name: Forgotten Coast
summary: Sea giants and water elementals roam Feralas’s western shore, where the Forgotten Coast meets the Veiled Sea.

sections.title: Edge of the Rainforest
sections.body: The rainforest ends at the Forgotten Coast, and the Veiled Sea opens beyond it. With no canopy overhead, the strand lies exposed to wind and weather. Sea giants tower over the shore while water elementals prowl the surf. Travelers crossing the forest must pass these ancient guardians to reach the water. A ferry carries them from the mainland to sardor isle, home of the night elven feathermoon stronghold.

faq.q: What threats wander the Forgotten Coast?
faq.answer: Sea giants and water elementals roam the Forgotten Coast, emerging from the Veiled Sea.

faq.q: How do you reach Feathermoon Stronghold from here?
faq.answer: Take the ferry across the channel from the coast to sardor isle, where the night elves hold feathermoon stronghold. Sea giants prowl the waters near the dock.

faq.q: Is the Forgotten Coast accessible to the Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. A northern path leads down to the coast, so Horde travelers can avoid the southern route toward the night elven crossing and its sentinels.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the coast links the Kalimdor mainland to feathermoon stronghold on sardor isle. Sea giants roam the shore, so stay alert.
As a Horde traveler, take the northern forest paths for safer passage to the water. The southern trail runs near night elven ferry points.
